name: io.github.itsnevu/bugglo-mcp
title: Bugglo
description: Read Robinhood Chain (4663) straight from the chain: rug checks, ownership, upgradeable-proxy and privileged-power disclosure, a read-only sell simulation, the official stock-token registry, and a pre-trade firewall that answers ALLOW / BLOCK / UNKNOWN. No API key, no account, no backend.
